title: The Sovereign Substrate: Reference Implementation
description: Python reference implementation of the Sovereign Substrate architecture. Approximately 3,500 lines of core substrate code, 4,500 lines of tests, and 9,000 lines of worked examples; 225 passing tests and twelve end-to-end demonstrations against substantively different problems (Universal Credit single and cross-operator, Horizon, Robodebt, Lavender, SolarWinds, CrowdStrike, Boeing 737 MAX, Five Eyes, LIBOR, London Whale, constitutional anchoring). Conforms to the architecture specified in 'The Sovereign Substrate: Reference Architecture and Implementation' (S. Wheeler, v1.0). The principal architectural treatise is 'The Sovereign Substrate: A constitutional architecture for governed computation' (S. Wheeler, v1.0; https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19960841).
